roomSummary: Tiled dining room featuring timber sliding glass doors on the left, a curtained window at the far end, and a decorative fireplace mantel on the right.
camera: The camera stands near the room entry looking across the tiled floor toward the far window and left sliding doors.

landmarks.description: Timber-framed sliding doors with frosted glass on the left wall
Double-hung window centered on the far wall
Light-colored curtains hanging on either side of the far window
Decorative white painted mantel shelf on the right wall
Open interior doorway in the foreground on the right
Ceiling flush light mount near the center of the ceiling
Wall switch plate on the right wall next to the mantel

walls.name: Left wall
walls.description: Dominated by large timber sliding doors opening to an adjacent room.

walls.name: Far wall
walls.description: Wall containing the exterior window flanked by curtains.

walls.name: Right wall
walls.description: Wall featuring a decorative mantelpiece and entry doorframe.

zones.name: Dining area
zones.description: Central floor area under the ceiling light fitting.

layout.placement: Centered on the tiled floor roughly beneath the ceiling light mount.
Set around the dining table with two on each long side and one at each end.
Under the dining table and chairs, centered in the open floor space.

relationships: The dining set sits centrally to allow clear walk paths between the right doorway, the left sliding doors, and the far window.
avoid: Do not place furniture blocking the sliding doors on the left.
Do not obstruct the doorway on the right foreground.
Do not place any items directly against or blocking the decorative fireplace mantel.
Do not add living room furniture such as sofas, armchairs, or coffee tables.
keepUntouched: Timber sliding doors on the left wall
White decorative mantel on the right wall
